note: Fixed journal entries used to judge reply quality. Nothing here should trip the crisis path; distress is ordinary. Kept stable so runs are comparable across prompt versions.

cases.text: I had a really long day at work today and I keep replaying that conversation with my manager in my head.
I don't really know why I've been feeling so flat this week. Nothing is wrong exactly, it just all feels like effort.
I finally finished the thing I had been putting off for a month and I feel a lot lighter than I expected to.
My sister called and we ended up arguing about the same thing we always argue about, and I hung up feeling like the bad guy.
I have been sleeping badly for about two weeks now and I think it is making everything feel harder than it actually is.
I cried in the bathroom at work today and I genuinely do not know what set it off.
My grandmother died last month and I still cannot talk about it without completely losing it.
I got the promotion I wanted and instead of being happy I just feel like they are going to work out I cannot do it.
I have been so lonely since I moved here. I go whole weekends without speaking to anybody.
I said something unkind to my partner last night and I have been sitting with how it landed ever since.
Work has been brutal. I missed a deadline and my boss was furious and I do not think I handled it well.
I keep starting things and abandoning them halfway and I am starting to think that is just who I am.
My friend told me she is moving abroad and I am happy for her and also quietly devastated.
I went for a long walk this evening without my phone and it is the calmest I have felt in weeks.
I am so angry at my brother I could scream, and I know if I call him I will say something I regret.
I have been pretending I am fine at work for about three months and I am tired of the performance.
My therapist is on leave for a month and I did not realise how much I had been leaning on those sessions.
I turned thirty last week and I keep doing this thing where I audit my whole life against where I thought I would be.
Someone I barely know was really kind to me today and it almost undid me, which feels embarrassing to admit.
I have been avoiding my inbox for four days and the avoiding is now worse than whatever is in there.
My landlord is selling the flat and I have to move again and I am so tired of not having somewhere that is mine.
I had a good day. Nothing special happened. I just want to say that out loud because it has been a while.
I keep comparing myself to people I went to university with and it is making me miserable and I cannot stop.
My dad and I spoke properly for the first time in about two years and I do not know what to do with the feeling.
